_meanings:
A kind of natural fodder (fed to elephants), consisting of
 branches and leaves of certain trees; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 11. 27</ls>. The word occurs
 sometimes in a ‘Dvandva compound’ with ‘kubala’ which also means the fodder
 which reduces phlegm and gall. <ab>cf.</ab> {#kabalaM nAmatastattu vAtalaM kaPapittahft .#}
